```{r}
#| label: datos
#| code-summary: "Ver código R: lectura y unión de tablas"
library(agricolae); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(knitr)

parcelas <- read.csv("datos/parcelas.csv")   # 28 unidades experimentales
plantas  <- read.csv("datos/plantas.csv")    # 112 plantas (submuestras)

orden <- c("T0 Testigo", "B100-K100", "B100-K150", "B100-K200",
           "B150-K100", "B150-K150", "B150-K200")
vars <- c(Ancho_fruto_cm = "Ancho (cm)", Longitud_fruto_cm = "Longitud (cm)",
          Peso_fruto_kg = "Peso (kg)", Longitud_corona_cm = "Corona (cm)", Brix = "°Brix")

# Unión de las dos tablas por la clave Parcela
d <- plantas |>
  left_join(parcelas |> select(Parcela:Potasio_ml), by = "Parcela") |>
  mutate(Bloque = factor(Bloque), Parcela = factor(Parcela),
         Tratamiento = factor(Tratamiento, levels = orden),
         Tipo = factor(Tipo, levels = c("Testigo", "Factorial")),
         Boro = factor(Boro_ml), Potasio = factor(Potasio_ml))
```

## Base de datos

La hoja original tenía cinco tablas apiladas, celdas de dosis vacías y encabezados en dos filas. Se
reorganizó como **base relacional**: dos tablas unidas por la columna `Parcela`.

```{r}
kable(head(parcelas, 7), caption = "Tabla 1. Unidades experimentales (7 de 28 filas)")
kable(head(plantas, 8), caption = "Tabla 2. Plantas evaluadas (8 de 112 filas)")
```

[Descargar base de datos (Excel)](datos/pina_relacional.xlsx){download="pina_relacional.xlsx"}

## Modelo estadístico

DBCA con submuestreo; arreglo factorial 2 (boro) × 3 (potasio) + testigo; 4 bloques; 4 plantas por parcela.

$$Y_{ijk} = \mu + \beta_j + \tau_i + \varepsilon_{ij} + \delta_{ijk}$$

| Término | Significado |
|---|---|
| $Y_{ijk}$ | Valor de la planta *k* del tratamiento *i* en el bloque *j* |
| $\beta_j$ | Efecto del bloque (*j* = 1…4) |
| $\tau_i$ | Tratamiento = testigo vs. factorial + boro + potasio + boro × potasio |
| $\varepsilon_{ij}$ | **Error experimental** (entre parcelas) → denominador de las pruebas F |
| $\delta_{ijk}$ | **Error de muestreo** (entre plantas de una misma parcela) |

## Análisis de variancia

```{r}
#| label: anva
#| code-summary: "Ver código R: ANVA con submuestreo para las 5 variables"
anva_sub <- function(v) {
  m <- aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ Bloque + Tipo + Boro + Potasio + Boro:Potasio + Error(Parcela)")), data = d)
  s1 <- summary(m)[["Error: Parcela"]][[1]]
  s2 <- summary(m)[["Error: Within"]][[1]]
  rownames(s1) <- trimws(rownames(s1)); rownames(s2) <- trimws(rownames(s2))
  tabla <- rbind(s1, s2)
  rownames(tabla) <- c("Bloque", "Testigo vs. Factorial", "Boro (B)", "Potasio (K)", "B × K",
                       "Error experimental", "Error de muestreo")
  sc_trat <- sum(s1[2:5, "Sum Sq"]); gl_trat <- sum(s1[2:5, "Df"])
  F_trat  <- (sc_trat / gl_trat) / s1["Residuals", "Mean Sq"]
  list(tabla = tabla,
       F_trat = F_trat, p_trat = pf(F_trat, gl_trat, s1["Residuals", "Df"], lower.tail = FALSE),
       glE = s1["Residuals", "Df"], cmE = s1["Residuals", "Mean Sq"],
       cv  = 100 * sqrt(s1["Residuals", "Mean Sq"] / 4) / mean(d[[v]]))
}
res <- lapply(setNames(names(vars), names(vars)), anva_sub)

estrellas <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
resumen <- sapply(res, function(r) {
  p <- r$tabla[1:5, "Pr(>F)"]
  c(paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r$tabla[1, "F value"]), " ", estrellas(p[1])),
    paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r$F_trat), " ", estrellas(r$p_trat)),
    paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r$tabla[2:5, "F value"]), " ", estrellas(p[2:5])),
    sprintf("%.2f", r$cv))
})
rownames(resumen) <- c("Bloque", "Tratamientos (6 gl)", "· Testigo vs. Factorial", "· Boro (B)",
                       "· Potasio (K)", "· B × K", "CV (%)")
colnames(resumen) <- vars
kable(resumen, caption = "Tabla 3. Valores F del ANVA para las 5 variables (** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, ns = no significativo)")
```

## Comparación de medias (Duncan)

```{r}
#| label: duncan
#| code-summary: "Ver código R: prueba de Duncan con el error experimental"
duncan <- lapply(names(vars), function(v) {
  du <- duncan.test(d[[v]], d$Tratamiento, DFerror = res[[v]]$glE, MSerror = res[[v]]$cmE)
  data.frame(Tratamiento = rownames(du$groups),
             media = du$groups[, 1], letra = trimws(du$groups$groups), Variable = vars[[v]])
}) |> bind_rows()

duncan |>
  mutate(celda = sprintf("%.2f %s", media, letra),
         Tratamiento = factor(Tratamiento, levels = orden)) |>
  select(Tratamiento, Variable, celda) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = celda) |>
  arrange(Tratamiento) |>
  kable(caption = "Tabla 4. Medias por tratamiento (n = 16 plantas). Letras distintas en una columna = diferencia significativa (Duncan, α = 0.05)")
```

## Gráficos

```{r}
#| label: fig-cajas
#| fig-cap: "Figura 1. Distribución de las 112 plantas por tratamiento. Rombo: media; letras: Duncan (α = 0.05)."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6.5
largo <- d |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(names(vars)), names_to = "v", values_to = "valor") |>
  mutate(Variable = factor(vars[v], levels = vars))
letras <- largo |>
  group_by(Variable, Tratamiento) |>
  summarise(tope = max(valor), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(duncan |> mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = vars),
                             Tratamiento = factor(Tratamiento, levels = orden)),
            by = c("Variable", "Tratamiento"))

ggplot(largo, aes(Tratamiento, valor)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#e8f1fa", colour = "#0b4f8a", width = 0.6, outlier.size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2.4, fill = "#0b4f8a", colour = "white") +
  geom_text(data = letras, aes(y = tope, label = letra), vjust = -0.6, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#0b4f8a"),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-calor
#| fig-cap: "Figura 2. Perfil de los tratamientos: media de cada variable estandarizada (z). Azul intenso = valor más alto entre tratamientos."
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 4.2
perfil <- duncan |>
  group_by(Variable) |>
  mutate(z = (media - mean(media)) / sd(media)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Tratamiento = factor(Tratamiento, levels = rev(orden)),
         Variable = factor(Variable, levels = vars))

ggplot(perfil, aes(Variable, Tratamiento, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", media), colour = abs(z) > 1.2), size = 3.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#c9772b", mid = "#f4f4f2", high = "#0b4f8a", midpoint = 0, name = "z") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "#1f2937"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## Análisis multivariado

```{r}
#| label: fig-pca
#| fig-cap: "Figura 3. Izquierda: correlación de Pearson entre variables (28 parcelas). Derecha: análisis de componentes principales; puntos = parcelas, flechas = variables."
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
library(patchwork)
X <- parcelas |> select(ends_with("_media"))
names(X) <- vars

cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor(X))) |>
  mutate(Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = vars), Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = rev(vars)))
g1 <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 3.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#c9772b", mid = "white", high = "#0b4f8a", limits = c(-1, 1), name = "r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Correlaciones") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())

pca <- prcomp(X, scale. = TRUE)
expl <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)
pts <- data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2],
                  Boro = ifelse(parcelas$Boro_ml == 0, "Testigo", paste(parcelas$Boro_ml, "ml B")),
                  Potasio = ifelse(parcelas$Potasio_ml == 0, "Testigo", paste(parcelas$Potasio_ml, "ml K")))
fl  <- data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2] * 3, var = rownames(pca$rotation))
g2 <- ggplot(pts, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Boro, shape = Potasio), size = 2.8) +
  geom_segment(data = fl, aes(0, 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(data = fl, aes(PC1 * 1.12, PC2 * 1.12, label = var), colour = "grey20", size = 3.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Testigo" = "grey45", "100 ml B" = "#0b4f8a", "150 ml B" = "#c9772b")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Testigo" = 1, "100 ml K" = 16, "150 ml K" = 17, "200 ml K" = 15)) +
  labs(x = paste0("CP1 (", expl[1], " %)"), y = paste0("CP2 (", expl[2], " %)"),
       title = "Componentes principales", colour = "Boro", shape = "Potasio") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

g1 + g2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.3))
```

## Conclusiones

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (v in names(vars)) {
  t <- res[[v]]$tabla
  du <- duncan[duncan$Variable == vars[[v]], ]
  fp <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))
  cat(sprintf("- **%s:** tratamientos %s (%s); interacción B × K %s (%s). Mayor media: %s (%.2f, grupo %s); testigo: %.2f (grupo %s).\n",
      vars[[v]],
      ifelse(res[[v]]$p_trat < 0.05, "significativos", "no significativos"), fp(res[[v]]$p_trat),
      ifelse(t["B × K", "Pr(>F)"] < 0.05, "significativa", "no significativa"), fp(t["B × K", "Pr(>F)"]),
      du$Tratamiento[1], du$media[1], du$letra[1],
      du$media[du$Tratamiento == "T0 Testigo"], du$letra[du$Tratamiento == "T0 Testigo"]))
}
R <- cor(X)
cat(sprintf("- El peso del fruto depende sobre todo de su longitud (r = %.2f) y no del °Brix (r = %.2f): un tratamiento puede aumentar el dulzor sin cambiar el tamaño del fruto.\n",
    R["Peso (kg)", "Longitud (cm)"], R["°Brix", "Peso (kg)"]))
```
